findings.title: Queue shutdown API is unavailable on supported Python versions
findings.body: `Queue.shutdown()` and `queue.ShutDown` were added in Python 3.13, while this service runs on older Python versions. On those versions this call raises `AttributeError` (which is swallowed here), leaving workers blocked forever in `Queue.get()`; setting `worker.shutdown` does not wake a blocked worker. Each shutdown therefore leaks worker threads, and the pool cannot drain or stop cleanly. Use a shutdown mechanism supported by the project's Python version, such as sentinels.

findings.title: Failed processing is marked complete and its offset can be committed
findings.body: The worker catches any exception from `result_processor` and then unconditionally calls `complete_offset` in `finally`. The commit loop treats that offset as successfully processed and can commit past it, permanently losing the message despite the strategy's stated guarantee that only successful processing is committed. Leave failed offsets outstanding or route them through the existing retry/DLQ behavior before completing them.

findings.title: Work queues are unbounded, so they provide no backpressure
findings.body: `queue.Queue()` defaults to `maxsize=0`, which is unbounded. If Kafka delivers faster than the workers process, submissions continue accumulating in memory rather than blocking or applying backpressure; a sustained backlog can exhaust the consumer's memory. Bound the queues or otherwise pause intake when queue capacity is reached.

findings.title: Closing a partition strategy shuts down the shared worker pool
findings.body: `ResultsStrategyFactory` owns one queue pool shared by the strategies it creates, but each `SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy.close()` shuts that pool down. Arroyo can close and recreate a strategy when partitions are reassigned; after the first close, the factory still points to this stopped pool, so subsequent strategies submit to workers that no longer process items. Make pool lifecycle factory-scoped, or give each strategy an independently owned pool.
